interventions.name: Glumetinib Combined with Fruquintinib
interventions.description:
Fruquintinib: 3mg, po.qd, d1-14，q3w;

Guemitinib:

Grade 1:200mg, po, qd, q3w; Grade 2:250mg, po, qd, q3w; Phase I: The dose of Glumetinib (200 mg → 250 mg) is dynamically adjusted using the "3+3 dose-escalation rule" to determine the optimal dose of Fruquintinib.

Phase II: The RP2D (Recommended Phase II Dose) of Glumetinib identified in Phase I is continued in combination with Fruquintinib.

primaryOutcomes.description: The dose determined during dose-escalation trials for use in Phase II studies, typically based on safety and tolerability data.
In the phase II study,CR + PR rate according to the RECIST version 1.1 guidelines.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The highest dose identified in dose-escalation trials that does not cause dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs).
Severe or intolerable toxicity events related to the study drug within a specified time window, which may influence dose-escalation decisions.
Assess adverse events according to the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (NCI CTCAE) v5.0
Proportion of patients achieving complete response (CR), partial response (PR), or stable disease (SD).
Overall survival is defined as the time from enrollment to death due to any cause.
In Phase I studies, CR + PR rate according to the RECIST version 1.1 guidelines.
Time from enrollment to disease progression (based on imaging or clinical assessment) or death from any cause.
